serving.scope: New raw strings, source-only64landmark exact prefix statistics and smooth routing. Reduced model-derived attention, not strictzero-neural images. No per-prompt fit or target fallback.

sourceCompile.covariancePolicy: FP64 block-centered full M2 matrices with Chan merge, population divisor; raw spectrum retained.
sourceCompile.metric: x=q/d^.25,y=k/d^.25; distance=(x-l)^T Cov_source(y)(x-l). Source score-displacement variance, not fresh-prefix read-error bound.
sourceCompile.routing: All-landmark RBF exp(-sourceScoreVariance/(2*tau2)); tau2 median positive nearest-other-landmark squared distance, or1 for degenerate source.
sourceCompile.scope: Source-only token/position covariance and query landmarks. No prompt string, contextual output or target-selected parameter enters fit.
sourceCompile.selection: Lexicographic identities; nearest weighted source-query mean, then deterministic farthest-first; selected identities excluded from later selection.
